en.name: Dahua IPC-HFW2439S Bullet Camera
en.shortDescription: 4MP bullet camera with AI human and vehicle detection.
en.description:
## Dahua IPC-HFW2439S

A 4MP bullet camera with built-in AI detection that tells people apart from vehicles to cut false alarms.

- 4MP resolution, full-color night vision
- Built-in microphone
- PoE powered, outdoor rated

## Dahua IPC-HFW2439S

Kaamirad bullet ah oo 4MP ah, oo si gudaha ah ugu dhisan ogaanshaha AI kaas oo kala saaraya dadka iyo baabuurta si loo yareeyo digniinaha been-abuurka ah.

- Sawir 4MP ah, aragti habeen oo midab leh
- Mic gudaha ku jira
- Waxaa lagu shaqaysiiyaa PoE, u adkaysan karta banaanka
